captures.description: THE NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The primary dedicated public resources and trackers for artificial intelligence litigation include:' Four bullets: 'DAIL – The Database of AI Litigation: Maintained by George Washington University Law School's Ethical Tech Initiative, this resource covers ongoing and completed AI-related cases starting from the initial complaint onward—regardless of whether they produce published decisions.'; Damien Charlotin's AI Hallucination Cases Database; Fisher Phillips's AI Litigation Tracker; Hogan Lovells's case law tracker. Five cards: GW Blogs, Fisher Phillips, Damien Charlotin, etidail.com, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader.
